scope: Gingin councillor vacancy; targeted official WAEC cross-check.

findings.finding: The Shire says Jason Weeks, elected in October 2023, resigned as councillor effective 3 November 2026. The notice was published on 5 November and says statutory requirements are being confirmed. No replacement process, candidate or election date was verified.
findings.access: Shire's dated notice directly read. No later process was identified in its public-notice index; the linked 17 November agenda PDF could not be read.

limits: The WAEC December notice confirms the existing 3 December postal elections. That notice does not determine this vacancy.
This scoped review does not recertify any other WA councillors, rosters or nominations.
